causes.text: Uber and Waymo launched an autonomous ride-hailing service in Atlanta, marking a major milestone in the deployment of self-driving vehicles and signalling escalating competition in the robotaxi market.

source_info.title: Uber, Waymo launch autonomous ride-hailing service in Atlanta

causes.text: Tesla's first robotaxi test rides in Austin sent its shares surging more than 9%, underscoring mounting investor enthusiasm for autonomous vehicles and intensifying the robotaxi race among mobility providers.

source_info.title: Tesla shares soar after first robotaxi test rides hit the road in Austin, Texas

effects.text: Uber partnered with Baidu to deploy thousands of Baidu's Apollo Go self-driving taxis in multiple global markets, signalling a strategic alliance to accelerate robotaxi deployment.

source_info.title: Uber partners with China's Baidu to deploy self-driving taxis in global markets

causal_reasoning_chain.description: Uber and Waymo's joint launch of autonomous ride-hailing in Atlanta and Tesla's successful robotaxi tests highlighted rapid progress by competitors and stoked investor excitement about driverless services.
The back-to-back milestones underscored that Uber needed to secure additional technology partners to keep pace with rivals in the robotaxi race.

Uber formed a strategic partnership with Baidu to deploy thousands of Apollo Go robotaxis in multiple markets, enabling it to scale autonomous services quickly and compete effectively, which made stock price of baidu rose 8.65%.

rationale: Competition from Waymo and Tesla heightened urgency for Uber to expand its autonomous vehicle programme. Partnering with Baidu provided the necessary technology and fleet scale, making the alliance a direct response to competitor progress.
counterfactual_analysis: Without the high-profile advances by Waymo and Tesla, Uber might have been less motivated to seek a new partner. The Baidu alliance could have been delayed or smaller in scope.

adversarial_confounders.impact: Uber's existing roadmap for autonomous vehicles may have included plans to collaborate with Baidu irrespective of competitor actions.
Changes in laws or incentives could have spurred Uber to expand its robotaxi partnerships independently of competitive pressures.

details.commentary: Back-to-back signals of softer demand and more cautious customer spending forced ASML and its clients to recalibrate their capex plans. As orders slowed and lead times normalized, the industry moved from scarcity to balance, dampening near-term growth but laying the groundwork for a healthier next upcycle.
